About The Coffee Party

A place where
coffee, music
and people
come together.

We believe a good day starts with good company. The Coffee Party brings coffee, music and people together, creating space to connect, let go and find a little more joy in the everyday.

Come for a cup. Stay for the feeling. Whether you arrive with your friends or meet someone on the dance floor, there’s room for you here. A shared rhythm. A familiar face. A morning that stays with you.
